highlights: Child Protection Act of Thailand alignment
UK Keeping Children Safe in Education guidance alignment
safety.policy_summary: At Kensington International School, student safety and well-being are top priorities, governed by a safeguarding policy aligned with both Thai laws (Child Protection Act) and UK guidance (Keeping Children Safe in Education). The school employs Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) to oversee child protection matters, ensure staff confidentiality, conduct regular training, and liaise with external agencies when necessary.
